global_caption: The video contains 6 shots. The entire Lighting comes mainly from ceiling lights in the museum and fluorescent lights in subway corridors. The emotional tone remains consistently slightly anxious and relieved upon catching the train.
shot1: Shot 1: Wide eye-level opening shot, composition centered on the information board in the museum lobby. Foreground features reflective floor and sparse traces of closing visitors; background extends into quiet, empty exhibition hall entrances. Three Caucasians — an adult man, an adult woman, and a teenager — form a triangular composition in front of the board. Cold white overhead lighting outlines their silhouettes sharply. ". The man and teenager simultaneously turn to look at her. The camera slowly pushes in to create a sense of uncertainty.
shot2: Shot 2, hard-cut from the previous shot, features a close-up eye-level push-in toward the boy, with focus locked on his face and eyes. The edge of the signboard is softly blurred in the background, serving as a spatial anchor. He quickly glances at the man, then turns to the woman, with clear and deliberate eye movement timing. "，说话时下巴轻抬示意通道方向，另外两人的肩部虚焦压在画面两侧形成过肩包围感，背景里电梯提示音短促响起，与少年指向动作同步，摄影机在他说到"ce côté,' a short push-in completes.
shot3: Shot 3: Hard cut into medium-wide tracking shot from previous shot. The trio has moved from the lobby into the museum corridor. Ground lines and wall light strips guide the viewer’s gaze toward the exit. The adult man leads slightly ahead, the woman and teenager walk side-by-side, fast-paced, with clothes and backpacks swaying slightly. Camera maintains eye-level side-rear tracking with slight handheld shake, naturally building urgency.
shot4: Shot 4: Short hard cut from previous shot, transitioning to medium over-the-shoulder shot at the turnstile. Foreground features cold metal edges of turnstile and security equipment. Background shows subway direction signs and glowing light strip deeper in the passage. The trio pauses briefly at the turnstile. " Her brows furrow, eyes rapidly shifting between man and teenager. The man raises hand slightly as if signaling forward. The teenager leans forward, ready to follow.
shot5: Shot 5: Hard cut linked by continuous motion from previous shot, entering medium-close eye-level tracking shot inside subway corridor. Corridor depth is evident, cold fluorescent lights extend along ceiling. Wall reflections show rapidly moving human silhouettes. The teenager is slightly behind center frame, first looking at the man, then quickly at the woman. The man in foreground turns head sideways to confirm. The woman runs while nodding. Camera pulls back slightly while tracking backward, making the trio’s spacing and pursuit direction clearly visible.
shot6: Shot 6: Hard cut to medium-to-close shot at platform edge. Train enters from right side of frame. Headlights and platform cold white lights illuminate their faces. Background shows blurred passing window reflections. The trio rushes to the doors, briefly exchanging glances for mutual confirmation. The woman immediately shows a relaxed expression. The teenager nods quickly.
